methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 verified string-trimmer models spanning gas, battery, and corded-system power sources. Milwaukee 2825-21ST excluded (discontinued, no verified current MSRP). Primary sources are official manufacturer product pages (EGO, Echo, Stihl, DeWalt, Husqvarna, Ryobi, Greenworks, Toro, Worx, Makita, BLACK+DECKER) plus authoritative retail/review sources (Pro Tool Reviews, ToolBoxBuzz, Tool Nut, Lowe's, Home Depot, Amazon, Acme Tools, The Power Tool Store, Farm & Fleet). Weights are bare-tool where separately published, otherwise noted. cutting_swath_in is the maximum rated width. priceUsd is the published US MSRP or standard retail for the most common kit named. Adversarial re-verification on 2026-06-19 corrected feed-type and line-diameter errors (Stihl AutoCut C 6-2 is bump feed with 0.080 in line; Toro Quick-Feed is manual not auto), a DeWalt kit-battery description (FLEXVOLT DCB609 = 3.0Ah in 60V mode), and two stale/mismatched source URLs. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: EGO POWER+ ST1623T 16" LINE IQ with POWERLOAD
products.priceNote: MSRP $329 (Lowe's/Acme list $329.99), kit with 56V 4.0Ah battery and 320W charger
products.provenance: EGO official page confirms 56V, continuous 16 in swath, 0.095 in line, LINE IQ autofeed (no bump), carbon-fiber telescopic shaft; 4.0Ah battery + 320W charger kit. Weight 7.7 lb bare tool per retailer specs; $329 MSRP confirmed across Acme Tools and PTR (Lowe's $329.99). 2024 release confirmed by PTR (first trimmer with LINE IQ).

products.name: DeWalt DCST972 FLEXVOLT 60V MAX 17" Brushless String Trimmer
products.priceNote: MSRP, DCST972X1 kit; FLEXVOLT DCB609 battery (9.0Ah in 20V mode, 3.0Ah in 60V mode) + charger. Product now marked discontinued on DeWalt.com
products.provenance: DeWalt official kit page (DCST972X1) confirms 60V MAX, 15/17 in adjustable swath (max 17 in), 0.080 in dual line (0.095 compatible), bump-feed quick-load spool, discontinued status. The included FLEXVOLT DCB609 is 3.0Ah in 60V mode (9.0Ah in 20V mode) — draft's '9.0Ah' priceNote corrected. Source URL corrected from tool-only (DCST972B) to the X1 kit. Straight shaft and 10.3 lb bare weight per Pro Tool Reviews; $329 kit MSRP per PTR/retailers.

products.name: Ryobi RY40250 40V Expand-It Attachment Capable String Trimmer
products.priceNote: Kit price with 4.0Ah battery and charger per Home Depot/ToolBoxBuzz; HD tool-only listed ~$179
products.provenance: ToolBoxBuzz review and Home Depot confirm 40V Expand-It system, 13-15 in adjustable swath (max 15 in), 0.080 in dimpled line, REEL-EASY bump-feed head, 8.92 lb tool weight, $159 kit price. Straight shaft per retailer specs. Release year not reliably published; left null.

products.name: Greenworks Pro ST80L210 80V 16" Brushless String Trimmer
products.priceNote: MSRP $229, kit with 2.0Ah battery and charger; Lowe's standard retail ~$249
products.provenance: Greenworks official and Lowe's confirm 80V, 14/16 in cut path (max 16 in), 0.080 in dual line, bump feed, straight shaft, 2.0Ah battery kit. 7 lb bare tool per Greenworks; 9.7 lb with battery per Consumer Reports. $229 MSRP confirmed across sources; Lowe's lists ~$249. Release year not published; null.

products.name: Husqvarna 525LST 25.4cc Gas String Trimmer
products.priceNote: Retail price per The Power Tool Store and authorized dealer listings
products.provenance: Husqvarna official page confirms 25.4 cm3 (25.4 cc), 19.3 in cutting width, 10.36 lb (excl. cutting equipment), straight shaft, Tap'n Go bump-feed head (AutoCut/T35X). 0.095 in is the standard line size. Price $399.99 confirmed by The Power Tool Store and PTR. Release year not published; null.

products.name: Echo SRM-225 21.2cc Straight Shaft Gas String Trimmer
products.priceNote: MSRP per Echo USA official; Home Depot street price often ~$249
products.provenance: Echo USA official page confirms 21.2 cc 2-stroke engine, 17 in swath, 0.095 in Cross-Fire line, Speed-Feed 400 bump head, straight shaft, 11.5 lb, $279.99 MSRP. Home Depot lists $279 original / ~$249 current. Release year not published; null.

products.name: Stihl FSA 60 R Battery String Trimmer
products.priceNote: MSRP tool only (bare unit) per Stihl USA; kit with AK 20 + AL 101 charger ~$359.99
products.provenance: Stihl USA page confirms 36V AK system, 13.8 in cutting width, $269.99 tool-only MSRP. Draft errors corrected: the AutoCut C 6-2 (EasySpool) head is a BUMP feed (tap-on-ground / twist bump knob), NOT auto-feed; it ships with 0.080 in (2.0 mm) line (0.095 max), so line_diameter corrected 0.095->0.080 and feed_type auto->bump. Straight shaft; ~7.3 lb bare. Kit with AK 20 + AL 101 ~$359.99 per Farm & Fleet.

products.name: Worx WG163 GT 3.0 20V 12" String Trimmer & Wheeled Edger
products.priceNote: Standard price, WG163 kit with 2 x 2.0Ah batteries and charger
products.provenance: Worx/Amazon/Best Buy confirm 20V, 12 in swath, 0.065 in line, ~5.29 lb bare (5.5 lb with battery on Amazon), straight shaft, push-button Command Feed auto-advance (no bump). $119.99 standard for dual-battery WG163 kit. Source URL corrected: draft's worx.com/...wg163-4.html is a Discontinued page, replaced with live Amazon WG163 kit listing. Release year not published; null.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER LSTE525 20V MAX EASYFEED 12" String Trimmer/Edger
products.priceNote: Kit price with 2 x 1.5Ah batteries and charger per Toolup; mass retail often ~$99
products.provenance: BLACK+DECKER official page confirms 20V MAX, 12 in swath, EASYFEED push-button advance (no bump), straight shaft, 2 x 1.5Ah battery kit. Line diameter 0.065 in per retailer spec sheets. Bare-tool weight ~5.3 lb (official page lists 8.8 lb gross/packaged). $129 kit from Toolup; ~$99 at mass retail. Release year not published; null.

products.name: Makita XRU15PT1 36V (18V X2) LXT Brushless String Trimmer Kit
products.priceNote: Published MSRP per Tool Nut (kit with 4 x 5.0Ah batteries and dual-port charger); MAP street price often lower
products.provenance: Makita USA and Tool Nut confirm 36V (dual-18V) system, 15 in swath, 0.080 in twisted quiet line, Bump & Feed head, straight-shaft loop-handle design with steel internal drive shaft, 7.6 lb bare tool (10.4 lb with battery), kit with 4 x BL1850B 5.0Ah batteries + dual-port charger. $664 MSRP per Tool Nut; actual street price lower under Makita MAP. Release year not published; null.

products.name: Toro 60V MAX 14"/16" Brushless String Trimmer (51830)
products.priceNote: MSRP, kit with 2.5Ah battery and charger per Toro official page (51830T tool-only is $159.99)
products.provenance: Toro official page confirms 60V MAX Flex-Force, 14-16 in adjustable swath (max 16 in), single 0.095 in line, straight shaft, 12 lb, $239.99 MSRP, 2.5Ah kit. Draft error corrected: the Quick-Feed no-spool system is a MANUAL thread-and-spin-dial feed, not automatic; feed_type auto->manual (it is no-bump but not auto-advancing). Release year not published; null.
